[[Category:Tranquility Cemetery, Tranquility, Ohio]]
== Biography ==
Margaret was born in 1819. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-653|Joseph Glasgow]] and [[Glasgow-876|Nancy Glasgow]]. She passed away in 1899.
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-653]] is assessed at 90% (proved). Faris’s 1990 Glasgow Family genealogy supplies the Joseph/Nancy family framework; Margaret is called Joseph/Nancy’s daughter, born 10 July 1819, with Faris p.34 and memorial support. Joseph’s reported 1820 Ohio death is compatible with the birth, but no original relationship passage is transcribed.

Selected father-profile identity and paternal relationship; maternal identity is separate.

Next useful test: Read Faris’s Joseph child list and trace this child’s original marriage/probate evidence.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-2243 Faris, David, The Glasgow Family of Adams County, Ohio (Baltimore, MD, Gateway Press, Inc., 1990), p.34]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
